subject: Return fragile tape
body: Hi, we have 4 cases of the printed fragile tape left over from SO-20771 that we never opened.
Can we return them for credit?

truth.handling: SO-20771 was delivered September 10, past the 30-day window, so the reply explains the policy and no return is opened.
